companies.name: The Organic Vegan
companies.distributes: Chocolates, sweets and biscuits, vegan biscuits and cookies and snacks such as Cheaky Co. roasted chickpea chyps, alongside vegan pantry, dairy-free and meat-free groceries
companies.channels_supplied: Its own 100% vegan supermarket in Cape Town and its online shop delivering across the Cape Town region
companies.fit_rationale: A 100% vegan supermarket, founded in 2018 in Table View, that runs a dedicated chocolates, sweets and biscuits category stocked with other brands such as Cheaky Co. and POWA. Diablo's vegan muesli bars, wafer, cookie, peanut butters and jams match its shoppers directly. Store count beyond the Cape Town shop and online store is not stated on its website.
what_they_do_well: Running a 100% vegan supermarket since 2018, with an online supermarket delivering across Cape Town.

companies.name: Vegan Things
companies.distributes: Spreads and nut butters, chocolate (chocolate pebbles, Goodness Me choc chips) and snacks from other vegan brands such as Cheaky Co., Earthshine Foods and Vegelicious, plus vegan pantry and cheese
companies.channels_supplied: Its own online shop, focused on Gauteng
companies.fit_rationale: An owner-run online vegan retailer whose own shop has a spreads and nut butters collection, chocolate lines and brand collections from other vegan makers. Diablo's vegan peanut butters, jams and muesli bars suit this range. Tier 3 because it is a small online shop and its delivery area beyond Gauteng is not stated on its website.
what_they_do_well: Built a Gauteng online vegan store featured by Daily Maverick in 2021 as part of South Africa's growing vegan market.

companies.name: Sweeto Africa
companies.distributes: Halal certified Turkish confectionery: marshmallows, jelly gummies and liquorice from the Sweeto brand
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale and trade customers in South Africa and neighbouring countries through trading accounts and local distribution partners
companies.fit_rationale: A Durban wholesaler and distributor of 100% halal Turkish sweets and gummies that opens trading accounts with shops, which matches the channel model of a halal importer supplying the trade with branded confectionery. Diablo's halal certified gummies and jelly sweets sit next to its range. Storage: sells from its own stock to trade accounts, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Distributes the Sweeto halal confectionery range across South Africa and surrounding countries through local distribution partners.

companies.name: Turkish Grand Bazaar
companies.distributes: Imported Turkish sweets and chocolate: Turkish delight gift boxes, Dubai chocolate, chocolate coated dragees, baklava and dried fruit, from Turkish brands such as Cerez Pazari, Musko and Bolci
companies.channels_supplied: Its own online shop with courier delivery, plus a wholesale page for trade buyers
companies.fit_rationale: A Cape Town online shop importing branded Turkish sweets, Dubai chocolate and dragees, products bought by the Muslim and Turkish shoppers this channel targets. Diablo's Dubai style chocolate, chocolate dragees and gift boxes match its best selling lines. Tier 3 because it is one online shop and its website does not state halal certification or how many trade buyers it supplies.
what_they_do_well: Imports baklava and Turkish delight straight from Turkey and sells them nationally online, with a separate wholesale offer.

companies.name: NetFlorist
companies.distributes: Chocolate gift boxes, hat boxes, crates, towers and truffles (Lindt, Nestle, Ferrero Rocher, Cadbury), nougat (Sally Williams), candy jars, cookies and snack hampers
companies.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers and corporate buyers nationwide through its own online shop and delivery network
companies.fit_rationale: South Africa's largest online gifting business, with chocolate and snack hampers built from other companies' brands such as Lindt, Ferrero Rocher and Cadbury. A branded sugar-free chocolate box or variety pack would sit naturally in its chocolate gift categories. Storage: own warehouses in Johannesburg and Cape Town, with in-house logistics hubs in Cape Town, Durban, Pretoria and Johannesburg.
what_they_do_well: Trading since 1999 and runs its own warehouses and in-house delivery hubs in four South African cities.

companies.name: Hamperlicious
companies.distributes: Chocolate hampers, hat boxes, crates and truffles (Lindt, Ferrero Rocher, Cadbury), nougat gifts, candy jars, cookies and snack hampers
companies.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers nationwide and corporate buyers through staff hampers and year-end corporate gifts
companies.fit_rationale: A national online hamper shop with more than 6,600 gifts, whose chocolate range is built on other companies' brands such as Lindt, Ferrero Rocher and Cadbury. It runs dedicated corporate and bulk staff hamper pages, so Diablo gift boxes and variety packs fit both its consumer and corporate lines. Head office city and warehouse are not stated on its website; it sells and delivers from its own online stock with same-day delivery on selected gifts.
what_they_do_well: Trading since 2012 and offers more than 6,600 curated gifts with nationwide delivery.

companies.name: Gift Lady
companies.distributes: Chocolate hampers, coffee, tea and cookies hampers, gourmet snack hampers and a diabetic-friendly hamper with sugar-free chocolate and sweets
companies.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers nationwide and corporate gift hampers for businesses
companies.sf_brands_carried: Chocwell sugar-free chocolate and Little Lovies sugar-free candies in its diabetic-friendly hamper
companies.fit_rationale: An established online gift and hamper shop that already sells a diabetic-friendly hamper filled with other brands' sugar-free chocolate and sweets, so it knows the buyer Diablo serves. Its chocolate, cookie and corporate year-end hampers give Diablo several places to sit. It already carries Chocwell, a direct sugar-free chocolate competitor.
what_they_do_well: Already sells a diabetic-friendly hamper built on branded sugar-free chocolate and sweets.

companies.name: Fabulous Flowers and Gifts
companies.distributes: Chocolate and sweets gift boxes (Lindt, Lindt Lindor, Ferrero Rocher), luxury biscuits, nougat, jams and snack hampers
companies.channels_supplied: Own shops in Claremont, Cavendish Square and Sea Point, a Johannesburg branch, nationwide online delivery and corporate accounts
companies.fit_rationale: A Cape Town gifting business with its own shops, a Johannesburg branch and corporate accounts for banks, law firms and agencies, whose chocolate and sweets boxes are built on Lindt and Ferrero Rocher. Shelf-stable boxes ship nationwide, which suits Diablo's ambient gift boxes. Its sister brand Flower Guy sells the same kind of hampers with Lindt, Ferrero Rocher, Cadbury and Darling Sweet.
what_they_do_well: Hand-packing chocolate and sweets boxes in its Claremont studio since 1999, with over 5,000 customer reviews.

companies.name: inMotion Flowers (formerly Flowers for Africa)
companies.distributes: Christmas, chocolate and snack hampers with Ferrero Rocher chocolates, Sally Williams nougat, biscuits, Christmas cake, candy canes and humbugs, plus Cadbury chocolate gift boxes
companies.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers and corporate gift buyers through hubs in Durban, Johannesburg, Cape Town, Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Gqeberha and East London
companies.fit_rationale: A national gift delivery business whose hampers combine other brands' chocolates, nougat, biscuits and sweets, with hubs in seven South African cities. Diablo's biscuits, chocolate and seasonal gift boxes match the mix in its Christmas and snack hampers. Head office address is not stated on its website.
what_they_do_well: Trading since 2009, with delivery hubs in seven South African cities.

companies.name: Yabulela Gift Hampers
companies.distributes: Gift hampers with biscuits, nougat bars, fudge, chocolate-coated treats, sugar sweets and chocolate, including kosher and halal hampers
companies.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers and corporate clients nationwide by courier, plus custom-packed event hampers
companies.sf_brands_carried: Offers diabetic and banting hampers on request
companies.fit_rationale: A corporate and consumer hamper company that packs biscuits, nougat, fudge and sweets bought from local suppliers into kosher, halal and corporate hampers. It already makes diabetic hampers on request, a natural home for Diablo's no-added-sugar range. Diablo's halal certificate and kosher products also suit its kosher and halal lines.
what_they_do_well: Offers kosher, halal and diabetic hampers and has packed corporate hampers since about 2010.

companies.name: LuluLocal
companies.distributes: Curated gifts with sweets and chocolates, biscuits and rusks, and dried fruit and savoury snacks from local brands
companies.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers online and corporate gifting for year-end, conferences and activations nationwide
companies.fit_rationale: An online gift shop and corporate gifting service that sells other South African brands' sweets, chocolates and biscuits and builds bespoke corporate boxes. It holds its own stock for daily turnaround and handles nationwide delivery, so it can take a branded imported range. Head office address and warehouse are not named on its website; it states that it holds stock.
what_they_do_well: Holds its own stock for fast daily turnaround and scales to conference and year-end gifting projects.

companies.name: Hamper World
companies.distributes: Sweets and chocolate hampers with Zanoni Chocolate, Chocoloza, Darling Sweet, fudge and gourmet popcorn
companies.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers with same-day delivery in Gauteng and nationwide delivery; gifts for colleagues and thank-you hampers
companies.fit_rationale: An online hamper shop with dedicated sweets and chocolate hamper categories filled with other brands such as Zanoni, Chocoloza and Darling Sweet. It says it prefers brands with natural ingredients, which suits Diablo's stevia and no-added-sugar positioning. Head office address is not stated on its website.

companies.name: Durban Florist
companies.distributes: Chocolate hampers and gift boxes with Lindt, Ferrero Rocher, Nestle and Cadbury chocolate, plus snack boxes
companies.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers in Durban with next-day delivery and a corporate section
companies.fit_rationale: A Durban gift and hamper shop with a chocolate hamper category built on Lindt, Ferrero Rocher, Nestle and Cadbury. It is tier 3 because it serves mainly Durban and its website does not describe its corporate offer or company size.

companies.name: Your Gifts
companies.distributes: Snack and chocolate hampers with Cadbury, Nestle, Kit Kat, Aero, Lindt, Whispers, Bar One and Milkybar, plus Mini Marie and Tennis biscuits and nougat
companies.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers online from Pretoria North
companies.fit_rationale: A small Pretoria online hamper shop whose snack and chocolate hampers are made up entirely of other companies' chocolate and biscuit brands. It is tier 3 because it is small and its website does not mention corporate orders.
